# Preface {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note}
This book is under construction. Chapters are placeholders while the
publishing pipeline is being set up.
:::

*Bayesian Biomechanics* is an interactive introduction to Bayesian data
analysis for biomechanics researchers. It assumes no prior experience with
Bayesian statistics and only a little Python.

## How the book works

Each chapter combines prose with interactive [marimo](https://marimo.io)
notebooks:

- **In the browser.** Lessons that only need lightweight tools (NumPy, SciPy)
  run directly in your browser through WebAssembly. Nothing to install.
- **On your computer.** Lessons that fit models with
  [PyMC](https://www.pymc.io) and [Bambi](https://bambinos.github.io/bambi/)
  run locally. The book shows their pre-computed results, and
  @sec-setup explains how to run them yourself.

## Further reading

Good general introductions to Bayesian data analysis include
@mcelreath2020 and @gelman2013.
